title: `_files -g '*.txt'` reached from a `zle -C` widget: zsh errors and inserts the .txt match, zshrs completes a directory

setup: local curcontext="$curcontext" state state_descr line ret=1
spec.completer:
#compdef fzc0007

local curcontext="$curcontext" state state_descr line ret=1
typeset -A opt_args

_arguments  \
  '*::arg name: _files -g '\''*.txt'\''' && ret=0

return ret

observed.notes: The widget's function IS the completer body, so there is no _main_complete frame above it. zsh reports `(eval):1: no matches found: *.txt:globbed-files` and still inserts `alpha.txt`; zshrs reports nothing and inserts the directory `adir/`, which the -g glob excludes. Two one-sided facts in one cell: the diagnostic only zsh emits, and the match set.

controls.note: the same completer through whatever compinit left on TAB (so _main_complete IS above it): PASSES.
